name: Discord Rich Presence
description: Shows what you're playing on your Discord profile, Spotify-style: "Listening to <artist>", the song, album art, a progress bar and a "Listen for free on Lumen" button. Off until you switch it on.
setup: Needs Discord running with the EquiPresence plugin (Vencord/Equicord) enabled. Lumen talks to it at 127.0.0.1:3210 using the token in ~/.equipresence/api-token. Switching this on shares what you listen to on your Discord profile.
